items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 5715.05/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-06-23 was Rs 5715.05/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 1092.83-10000.0/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Peak-hour (18:00-24:00) MCP premium: +51.6% vs daily avg
items.detail: Peak-hour average MCP was Rs 8663.29/MWh vs the day's overall average of Rs 5715.05/MWh, a +51.6% divergence.
